summary: Accepted R3 (#4822, PR #4828, hosted run 39926328205): a knowledge-bearing typed console workspace created on public SDD.Cli 2.2.0 / Workspace.Template 0.19.0 upgrades in place to 2.4.0 / 0.19.3 through owner actions. The owner runs a global and a local dotnet tool update (the SDK may add rollForward:false) and copies the drop-in descriptor. SDD's own templateRePin step is inert by design (HandlersUpgrade), and doctor/upgrade leave the tool manifest and providers.yml to the owner. Knowledge search/get/history output is byte-identical between 2.2.0 and 2.4.0, and get-version recovers pre-upgrade versions. History spans the upgrade, and the 10,485,760-byte write-path and checker boundaries hold. Doctor skillDriftPaths reports divergence between the mirrored .agents and .claude copies, not edits against provenance. An owner edit applied identically to both mirrors is not drift; editing one copy flags both paths. A deleted seeded skill is reported as missing and as drift; upgrade --yes re-seeds only that skill and never overwrites owner edits (residualDrift stays true). The console and fs-gg-project-knowledge payloads are byte-identical in 0.19.0 and 0.19.3, so the template half moves identity only. Re-applying the overlay without --force refuses with exit 73. Accepted R4 (#4822, PR #4832, hosted run 39931369727, fdev acceptance 2026-10-23) covers pre-knowledge adoption. SDD.Cli 2.0.3 with the Templates 908da309 descriptor (0.13.0) scaffolds typed-sdd with no store, guide or knowledge CI. 2.0.3 refuses knowledge as unknownCommand (report on stderr, exit 1). Steps: the 0.19.3 overlay adds two CI files, and its checker refuses until initialization because the guide is missing. Global and local tool updates move to 2.4.0. The drop-in descriptor is copied; whether adoption needs that copy was not isolated. knowledge initialize then creates the guide, schema and seed, appends the ignore block after the owner .gitignore, and is idempotent. Known limits of an adopted workspace, filed as FS.GG.SDD#1123: CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md never gain the 2.4.0 knowledge pointer (no-clobber), and doctor does not report a deleted guide, because 2.0.3 provenance omits it. Scope: console only, one Linux host, Coord stays at 0.94.0, tied to these exact public packages.
title: Retained Typed SDD workspaces: in-place knowledge upgrade and pre-knowledge adoption
